CJFG.description: Concurrent Joint Force Group (CJFG). A singleton record (key is always 1) holding the set of structure group names whose joint forces are combined concurrently for moving-load analysis; the sole GROUPS field lists those groups.

GROUPS.description: Set of structure group names forming the Concurrent Joint Force Group. Each entry must be the name of an existing structure group; the handler resolves each name to a group key and rejects the request (CONTINUE error) if any name does not exist.
